candidates.name: Hepatoblastoma
support_spans: a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe
candidates.why: The patient's presentation with a large abdominal mass and symptoms such as abdominal pain and distension suggests a liver tumor.

candidates.name: Hepatic hemangioma
support_spans: a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe
candidates.why: The mixed solid and cystic nature of the mass could be consistent with a hepatic hemangioma.

candidates.name: Tumor thrombus
support_spans: an infrarenal IVC thrombus and a near-occlusive embolus in the left pulmonary artery
candidates.why: The patient's development of an IVC thrombus and pulmonary embolus suggests a tumor thrombus.

candidates.name: Budd-Chiari syndrome
support_spans: compression of the distal IVC at its junction with the right atrium
candidates.why: The compression of the IVC at its junction with the right atrium could be consistent with Budd-Chiari syndrome.

candidates.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
support_spans: contrast-enhanced CT of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis demonstrated an infrarenal IVC thrombus
candidates.why: The presence of an IVC thrombus on CT scan could be diagnostic of hepatocellular carcinoma.

candidates.name: Wilms tumor
support_spans: a 17 × 9 cm mixed solid and cystic mass occupying the right hepatic lobe
candidates.why: The large size of the abdominal mass could be consistent with Wilms tumor.
